name: RoboBot Coding Kit
description: An interactive robot that teaches children programming basics through fun games and challenges. Includes 50+ coding activities, a companion app, and 3 difficulty levels. Perfect for introducing kids to computational thinking and problem-solving skills.

name: Science Lab Explorer
description: Complete chemistry and physics experiment kit with 100+ safe experiments. Includes lab equipment, safety goggles, detailed instruction manual, and educational videos. Covers topics like chemical reactions, electricity, magnetism, and more.

name: Math Puzzle Master
description: Advanced mathematical puzzle set with 200+ brain-teasing challenges. Includes geometric puzzles, number games, logic problems, and spatial reasoning activities. Perfect for developing mathematical thinking and analytical skills.

name: Engineering Bridge Builder
description: Construction kit for building various types of bridges and structures. Includes 500+ building pieces, engineering challenges, and educational materials about structural engineering principles. Teaches physics concepts through hands-on building.

name: Tech Circuit Board
description: Electronics learning kit with breadboard, components, and 50+ circuit projects. Teaches basic electronics, circuit design, and programming with Arduino compatibility. Includes LED displays, sensors, and motors for interactive projects.

name: Preschool STEM Starter
description: Gentle introduction to STEM concepts for toddlers and preschoolers. Includes colorful building blocks, simple experiments, and educational games. Designed for small hands with safety-tested materials and easy-to-follow instructions.

name: Board Game Logic Quest
description: Strategic board game that combines logic puzzles with adventure gameplay. Players solve mathematical challenges, decode patterns, and use critical thinking to advance through levels. Includes 100+ unique puzzles and multiplayer mode.

name: Chemistry Magic Set
description: Safe chemistry experiments kit with colorful reactions and educational demonstrations. Includes non-toxic chemicals, safety equipment, and detailed explanations of chemical principles. Perfect for sparking interest in chemistry.

name: Robot Arm Constructor
description: Mechanical engineering kit for building a functional robotic arm. Includes motors, gears, sensors, and detailed assembly instructions. Teaches mechanical principles, automation concepts, and basic robotics engineering.

name: Math Adventure Game
description: Interactive math learning game with 300+ problems across multiple difficulty levels. Covers arithmetic, geometry, algebra, and problem-solving strategies. Includes progress tracking, rewards system, and adaptive difficulty.

name: Solar System Explorer
description: Astronomy kit with telescope, star charts, and educational materials about space science. Includes 50+ astronomy activities, planet models, and interactive learning resources. Perfect for exploring the universe from home.

name: Wind Power Generator
description: Renewable energy kit for building a working wind turbine. Includes generator components, LED lights, and educational materials about sustainable energy. Teaches physics principles and environmental science concepts.

name: DNA Extraction Kit
description: Biology experiment kit for extracting DNA from fruits and vegetables. Includes laboratory equipment, educational materials, and step-by-step instructions. Teaches molecular biology concepts and scientific methodology.

name: 3D Printing Pen
description: Creative 3D printing pen with temperature control and safety features. Includes 50+ meters of PLA filament in various colors and educational projects. Teaches spatial reasoning, design thinking, and creative problem-solving.

name: Microscope Discovery Kit
description: High-quality microscope with 400x magnification and prepared slides. Includes 50+ prepared slides, blank slides, cover slips, and educational materials. Perfect for exploring the microscopic world and biology education.
